data.cultural_impact: In Hindu society, the name "Challa" is given to young boys. It is a common name among the Hindu community in the states of Andhra Pradesh and Telangana in India. It is also a popular name among other Hindu communities in different parts of the world.
data.spiritual_significance: The name "Challa" has spiritual significance in Hinduism. Challa is the name of Lord Shiva's mount or vehicle, the bull Nandi. The name also appears in the K scholarships application hymns of the Rigveda as the name of a sage. This suggests that the name is connected to the divine and represents the qualities of youth, strength, and purity. Additionally, the name is also believed to bring good luck and prosperity to the bearer.

historical_references.reference: Historical records show that The name Challa is mentioned in the Mahabharata as a region in the kingdom of Hastinapura. The name Challa carried significant spiritual weight in that era.
historical_references.context: The name Challa is associated with the Vedic period and is mentioned in the Mahabharata as a region in the kingdom of Hastinapura.
